r4_alias: r4_train_longer is exactly the V1 architecture/recipe; uses the V1 paired reruns.
validation_protocol: Same targets, all versions/arms: original 512, other books 128 each. Selection loss = .25 original + .25 legacy five-book macro + .50 additional-book macro. Check every 200 updates; seed 2026.
test_protocol: All paired and long selections finish before performance testing. Original all 16300 targets and five legacy books 2048 each reuse exact prior targets. New books: 512 distinct targets each, seed 2032, equal-book macro.
sampling_protocol: Control preserves original rehearsal weights. Large gives .20 to that legacy distribution and .80 to additional books weighted by training bytes.
limitations: One seed, changed genre/domain distribution, within-book holds, imperfect OCR; V3-V7 use the same previous parent in each arm, not a newly chained lineage. Byte accuracy is not coherence; fixed-lexicon sample scores are spelling proxies.
